high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a Twitter feed displaying two tweets. The top tweet is from a user named "Science girl" with the handle @gunsnrosesgirl3. The tweet reads: "Size of the waves in Nazare, Portugal," and includes a photo of a large wave crashing onto a rocky shore. A crowd of people is gathered on the cliff overlooking the ocean, watching the wave. Some individuals appear to be taking photos or videos, while others are simply observing the scene. The setting appears to be during the day under clear skies, as indicated by the bright lighting and shadows cast on the ground.
